race.comment: TEN DEEP (7) didn't have the cleanest of runs when resuming at Eagle Farm but was good second-up when closing off strongly into third here. Gets in well at the weights with Youngberry's claim and can put it all together now. HELL (2) has speed to burn and drops back from Listed company. Gets help at the weights with the apprentice taking back over and is sure to give them something to catch. AMUSEANTES (12) has returned in career-best form this campaign and finds another nice race for him to flex some muscle. Could look to go back from his draw, so will be hoping HELL overdoes it in front for him to launch late. SER JOH (6) has patchy form but shoulders peaks that stack up. Thompson's booking suggests he can put in a better showing. FACUNDO (5) is another runner who will be hoping for a strong tempo so he can get into his work late over a course and distance he relishes. Not dismissing.
